news.headline: Crypto exchange Gemini not at fault for collapse of Earn lending program, arbitrator says
news.summary: Gemini cleared of misconduct in the collapse of its Earn lending program. An arbitrator ruled the crypto exchange didn't mislead users, offering a legal win for the platform amid broader scrutiny of digital asset lending practices.

news.headline: BYD shares slide as fierce China competition dents first-half earnings
news.summary: BYD's stock slipped Friday despite posting higher Q2 profits and expanding overseas—signaling that intense domestic competition in China's EV market is weighing on investor sentiment. The automaker's earnings beat wasn't enough to offset concerns about margin pressures at home.

educational.title: How Interest Rates Actually Move Your Money
points: The Fed sets a target rate that ripples into loans, mortgages, and savings
Higher rates make borrowing pricier — car loans and mortgages cost more
Higher rates also make saving pay better — bank yields tend to rise too
Stocks often wobble on rate news because future profits get discounted more
You don't need to predict rates — just understand why headlines move markets
